title: ShipRules
description:
Tunables for ships, mining, lanes and control tiers. Saved with the world, so a
save keeps the rules it was played with until something changes them.

ControlRules.description:
Control tiers as progression. Each input mode is unlocked by a per-save flag
(`Player::flags`); the flag names are data.

automation.description: The player's automated craft may run saved loops.

click_dock.description: Click a station: fly into the ring and dock.

click_fly.description: Click a point near the ship: fly there and stop.

click_fly_range.description: How far from the ship a click-to-fly point may be (map travel has no limit).

click_mine.description: Click a rock: fly into reach and mine.

loop_limit.description: Most orders in a saved loop.

loops.description: Save a queue as a named loop and run it.

map_travel.description: Click anything on the map, any distance, routing through lanes.

queues.description: Shift-click appends orders to a queue.

CounterKind.description: Activity counters. Pacing reads these, never a clock.

oneOf.description: Sales and deliveries, one per transaction.
Handovers to a ledger (goal deliveries, station growth, dispute tallies).

approach.description:
A dock order steers until the ship is this far into the ring (share of its
radius from the centre), then docks.

transfer_reach.description:
A coupled hull hands cargo to a tender within this distance in space (both
docked at the same station always works).

EdgeRules.description:
The edge of the play space. Past its region's edge (the drawn region circle) a
current carries a ship back in: never an invisible wall.

min_speed.description:
The current is at least this fast past the edge, so it brings a ship all the
way back.

pull.description: World units per second the current gains for each unit past the edge.

FlightRules.description:
Flight feel. By hand the ship flies with tank controls and inertia: A/D turn, W/S
thrust along the heading, Space brakes, Shift boosts, and letting go coasts until
the auto-brake stops it. Orders (click to fly, automation) steer straight to their
point with the same top speed, acceleration and brake.

accel_time.description: Seconds from rest to top speed, for hulls without their own `accel`.

arrive_distance.description: A fly order is done within this many world units of its point.

auto_brake.description:
By hand, letting go of thrust stops the ship in `stop_time` seconds from any
speed. Off: it coasts by inertia only.

boost.description: Shift multiplies top speed and acceleration by this.

brake.description:
Braking is this many times stronger than accelerating, for hulls without their
own `brake`.

inertia.description:
By hand: 0 stops the moment thrust ends, 1 coasts for ever. In between,
sideways speed swings round into the new heading and coasting bleeds off.

turn_rate.description: Degrees per second, for hulls without their own `turn_rate`.

turn_slowdown.description:
Share of top speed lost while an order flies directly away from the heading
(0..=1). The ship swings round to face where it goes.

zoom.description:
The camera's zoom: 1.0 shows 440 world units top to bottom, 0.8 shows 550.
Ship modifiers (`zoom`) multiply it.

LaneRules.description: Lanes are currents: every hull rides them at the same speed and can't steer.

mouth_radius.description: A ship within this distance of a lane mouth can enter the lane.

speed.description: World units per second inside a lane.

radius_base.description: A full rock's radius is `radius_base + radius_per_sqrt_unit * sqrt(initial)`.

reach.description: A ship mines while within this distance of a rock's edge.

spent_scale.description:
A mined-out rock shrinks to this share of its full radius; in between it scales
with the square root of its remaining share. This is the size the game draws:
clicks, mining reach and mine orders all measure from it.

standoff.description: A mine order parks this far outside the rock's edge.

RegrowthRules.description: How rocks regrow. Driven by activity counters in the field's region, never by time.

pulses.description: Region counters that make up a region's activity ("region pulses"), with weights.

reform_share.description:
A spent rock reforms (can be mined again) once regrowth has brought it back to
this share of its full yield. Reforming adds no units of its own.
